classification.notes: This is a DTCC operational notice about a DTC global lock (chill/freeze) on a single defunct issuer (RVL Pharmaceuticals PLC, CUSIP G6S41R101) following its legal dissolution and transfer agent resignation. It is an internal DTC administrative action on one small, already-delisted security with no remaining assets. No card in the catalog covers DTC chills/freezes on individual defunct issuers, and the event does not describe a market, regulatory, member stress, or infrastructure event that maps to any card's Step 1 trigger.
